## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, …)
- [ ] `yarn build` passes (bundle + type-check)
- [ ] `yarn test` passes
- [ ] New/changed algorithms have tests (non-terminating ones only on inputs that finish quickly)
- [ ] The joke is preserved — no algorithm was accidentally turned into a real, efficient sort
- [ ] `readme.md` updated if behavior or API changed
